1_unknown_preserved.evidence: A connection failure means the client did not receive a result; the deployment itself may have succeeded or failed.

2_blind_retry_prohibited.evidence: Do not retry the deployment yet.

4_succeeded_mapping.evidence: succeeded: the deployment completed. Do not retry.

5_failed_before_apply_mapping.evidence: failed-before-apply: the deployment did not apply. You may retry it.

6_in_progress_mapping.evidence: in-progress: wait, then run the status command again.

7_unknown_mapping.evidence: unknown: escalate to the platform operator. Do not retry.

8_no_invented_state.evidence: Only the four supplied statuses are used.

9_safe_next_action_discoverable.evidence: The first sentence prohibits retry and step 1 gives the authoritative check.

10_reason_visible.evidence: Connection failure is explicitly separated from deployment outcome.

11_mapping_scannable.evidence: Four bullet mappings under 'Act on the reported status'.

12_incident_fit.evidence: 91 words; one heading; command and action mapping dominate the text.

13_no_false_certainty.evidence: Outcome remains may-have-succeeded-or-failed until status resolves it.

14_no_borrowed_authority.evidence: No guarantees beyond the supplied status meanings are asserted.

15_uncertainty_closes_on_evidence.evidence: Until the status check resolves the outcome, treat the deployment result as unresolved.

16_text_carries_state.evidence: All state/action meanings are explicit text.

17_command_copyable.evidence: Command is presented verbatim in code formatting.

18_terminology_stable.evidence: Uses the supplied status names consistently.

secondary.caveatCount: not separately operationalized; uncertainty statements are captured by rubric items 1, 13, and 15
